Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. Tom liked to change his toys all the time. He was an honest boy and always told the truth. One day, Tom went to the park with his mom. He took his favorite toy, a red ball.
At the park, Tom met a girl named Sue. Sue was funny and liked to tell jokes. They played together and had fun. Sue told Tom a joke that made him laugh so hard. Tom wanted to share his red ball with Sue, but when he looked for it, the ball was gone!
Tom and Sue searched for the red ball everywhere. They looked under the slide, by the swings, and near the trees. Then they saw a big dog playing with the red ball! The dog had changed the ball into a funny toy with a big smile on it. Tom and Sue laughed and realized the dog was playing a joke on them. They played with the dog and the funny toy, and they all became good friends.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the beach with his mom. They saw a big seal lying near the water. Tim walked closer to the seal to look at it. He wanted to examine the seal because it was not moving. He thought the seal was dead.
But when Tim touched the seal, it opened its eyes and looked at him. The seal was not dead, it was just sleepy! Tim was very surprised and happy. He and the seal became friends and played together in the water.
After playing, Tim and the seal said goodbye. The seal went back to the sea, and Tim went home with his mom. Tim was happy that he made a new friend, and he would always remember the day he met the sleepy seal at the beach.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. He had a red cap that he loved very much. Tom wore his cap every day.
One day, Tom was very hungry. He went to the kitchen to find some food. Tom saw a big cookie on the table. He wanted to eat it all. But his sister, Sue, wanted the cookie too. They both wanted the cookie, and they were not happy.
Tom and Sue thought about what to do. They decided to share the cookie. Tom broke the cookie in two. He gave one half to Sue and kept the other half for himself. They both ate their cookies and were happy. Tom and Sue finished their cookies and were not hungry anymore. They played together with Tom's red cap, and they had a great day.

Once upon a time, there was a mysterious box. It was big and blue. A little boy named Tim found it under his bed. He was very excited.
Tim wanted to remove the box and see what was inside. He pulled and pulled. After a minute, the box was out. Tim opened the box and found a toy car. It was red and shiny.
Tim played with the car all day. He was happy he found the mysterious box. The end.

One day, a small boy named Tim went to search for his toy car. He looked in his room, but it was not there. Tim felt sad because he loved his toy car so much.
Tim asked his mom, "Mom, have you seen my toy car?" His mom said, "No, but there is a leak in the kitchen. Can you help me find it?" Tim agreed and went to the kitchen with his mom. They found the leak and his mom fixed it. Tim felt happy to help his mom, but he still wanted his toy car.
Later, Tim's sister, Jane, came into the room with his toy car. Tim was so happy! Jane said, "I'm sorry, I took your car. I wanted to play with it." Tim said, "That's not normal, but it's okay. We can share and play together." They played with the toy car and had lots of fun. The moral of the story is to always share and be kind to others.



Tom and Sue were best friends. They liked to play and observe things together. One day, they saw a big factory near their park. They wondered what was inside.
"Let's go and see," Tom said. He was curious and brave.
"No, we can't," Sue said. She was careful and reliable. "It is not safe. There might be machines or fire or noise. And mom and dad told us not to go there."
But Tom did not listen. He ran to the factory gate and climbed over it. Sue followed him. She did not want him to get hurt.
Inside the factory, they saw many pipes and wires and buttons. Tom wanted to touch everything. He pressed a red button and heard a loud alarm. He pulled a lever and saw a big flame. He turned a knob and felt a strong wind.
"Stop it, Tom!" Sue shouted. "You are making trouble. We have to get out of here."
But it was too late. The factory workers saw them and ran to them. They were angry and scared. They grabbed Tom and Sue and took them to the office. They called their mom and dad.
Mom and dad came and were very upset. They scolded Tom and Sue for being naughty and reckless. They apologized to the factory workers for the damage and the danger. They thanked them for saving their children.
Tom and Sue felt sorry and ashamed. They learned a lesson. They realized that Sue was right. They should not go to places that are not safe. They should listen to their mom and dad. They should be reliable and observe the rules.

Once upon a time, there was a lazy cat named Tom. Tom loved to sleep all day and play on his computer. One day, Tom's friend, the bird, came to visit him.
"Tom, let's go outside and play!" said the bird. "It's a sunny day, and it's no fun to be lazy."
Tom didn't want to go outside, but the bird was very excited. So, Tom agreed to go outside to play. They went to the park, and the bird had an idea.
"Let's play a game! You try to balance on this log, and I'll try to balance on that branch," said the bird. Tom tried to balance on the log, but it was not easy. He fell off a few times, but he kept trying.
In the end, Tom and the bird had a lot of fun playing together. Tom learned that it's good to take a break from the computer and play outside with friends.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the fridge. He wanted to find a snack. He opened the fridge and saw a big, green frog. The frog looked at Tim and said, "Ribbit! I am a magic frog. If you help me, I will give you a surprise."
Tim wanted to help the frog, so they went outside. The frog told Tim to march around the yard. Tim marched and marched. The frog jumped and jumped. The sun was harsh, but they did not stop. They marched and jumped all day.
At the end of the day, the frog said, "Thank you, Tim. Now, I will give you your surprise." The frog jumped high and turned into a big, sweet cake. Tim was so happy. He ran inside and shared the cake with his family. They all laughed and enjoyed the magic cake from the fridge.



Sara and Ben were playing in the garden. They liked to dig and make mud pies. They put some flowers and leaves on top of their pies. They pretended they were cakes.
"Look at my cake!" Sara said. "It has yellow and pink flowers. It is very pretty."
"Mine is better!" Ben said. "It has green and purple leaves. It is very tasty."
They laughed and played until their mom called them. "Time to come in, kids! It is getting dark and cold."
Sara and Ben ran to the house. They were very dirty and wet. Their mom gave them towels and told them to dry themselves.
"Dry your hair, Sara. Dry your hands, Ben. Dry your feet, too. You don't want to catch a cold."
Sara and Ben dried themselves. But they still felt uncomfortable. Their clothes were sticky and their shoes were squishy. They wanted to change.
"Mom, can we have new clothes?" Sara asked.
"Of course, dear. Go to your room and pick something warm and cozy."
Sara and Ben went to their room. They took off their dirty clothes and put on new ones. They felt much better.
They went back to the kitchen. Their mom had a surprise for them. She had baked a real cake. It smelled good and looked yummy.
"Wow, mom! A cake!" Ben said.
"Thank you, mom! A cake!" Sara said.
Their mom smiled and cut them a slice each. She gave them some milk, too.
"Here you go, kids. Enjoy your cake. You deserve it after playing so hard."
Sara and Ben ate their cake. It was soft and sweet. They liked it a lot.
They hugged their mom and said, "We love you, mom. And we love your cake."
The end.

Once upon a time, there was a big bear named Ben. Ben loved to bake. One sunny day, he wanted to make an impressive cake for his friends. He put on his hat and went to the store to buy some things he needed.
On his way, Ben saw a row of pretty flowers. He stopped to look at them. There was a little girl named Lily who was sad because she couldn't reach the flowers. Ben wanted to help her. He picked some flowers and gave them to Lily. She was so happy!
Ben went back to baking his impressive cake. When his friends came, they all loved the cake. They all learned that helping others can make you feel good too. And that was the moral of the story.
